title: Tris Buffered Saline (TNT)
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.brdkm24w
materials: Table 1. Reagent volumes for 10X TNT preparation
Table 2. Reagent volumes for 1X TNT preparation

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Calibration
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and ensure all measuring instruments are accurate.

substeps.instruction: Obtain and label an RNase-free container (2 liter bottle or carboy) with reagent name, date, and initials.
Add an RNase-free stir bar to the container.
Ensure the pH meter is calibrated.
Ensure the balance is calibrated.

steps.title: Prepare 10X TNT Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 10X TNT stock solution (or refer to Table 1 for other volumes).

substeps.instruction: Measure and add 500 ml of MilliQ water to the labeled RNase-free container with the stir bar.
Measure and add 300 ml of 5M NaCl to the container.
Place the container on a stir plate and set to a high setting (7 or higher).
Weigh out 121.14 g TRIS base using a calibrated balance.
Slowly add the weighed TRIS to the container while stirring.
Adjust the pH to 7.60 using a calibrated pH meter.
Adjust the final volume to 1000 ml with MilliQ water.
Remove the stir bar using a magnetic stir bar remover.

steps.title: Prepare 1X TNT from 10X Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 1X TNT using the 10X stock solution (or refer to Table 2 for other volumes).

substeps.instruction: Measure 875 ml of MilliQ water and add to a labeled RNase-free container with a stir bar.
Using a 50 ml serological pipette, add 100 ml of 10X TNT to the water.
Place the container on a stir plate and set to a high setting (7 or higher).
Adjust the pH to 7.60 using a calibrated pH meter.
Using a sterile 10 ml serological pipette, add 7.5 ml of 10% Tween-20.
Adjust the final volume to 1000 ml with MilliQ water using the container's graduation marks or a graduated cylinder.
Remove the stir bar using a magnetic stir bar remover.

steps.title: Prepare 1X TNT without Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 1X TNT directly from base reagents.

substeps.instruction: Measure 800 ml of MilliQ water and add to a labeled RNase-free container with a stir bar.
Place the container on a stir plate and set to approximately 300 RPMs.
Add 30 ml 5N NaCl using a serological pipette.
Weigh out 12.114 g Tris base using a calibrated balance and slowly add it to the container while stirring.
Adjust the pH to 7.60 using HCl with a calibrated pH meter located in a fume hood.
Using a sterile 10 ml serological pipette, add 7.5 ml of 10% Tween.
Adjust the final volume to 1000 ml with MilliQ water using the container's graduation marks or a graduated cylinder.
Remove the stir bar using a magnetic stir bar remover.

steps.title: Storage and Disposal
steps.instruction: Store the prepared solutions at room temperature and dispose of waste according to guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Store 10X TNT at room temperature (expires after 4 weeks).
Store 1X TNT at room temperature (expires after 2 weeks).
Dispose of excess or expired reagent down any sink or directly into the municipal sewer system.
Clean reusable carboys or place disposable containers in the plastic recycling bin.
